articles.headline: From Leicester to Leverkusen, Mjällby join unlikely league champions
articles.description: Mjällby, the team from a fishing village with a population of 800, are league champions! When it comes to shock title wins, they are in good company.

images.name: Mjallby celebrate winning Swedish title [1296x729]
images.credit: JOHAN NILSSON/TT NEWS AGENCY/AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Could another team repeat Leicester's shock Premier League title win?
images.caption: Tom Hamilton joins "The Football Reporters" podcast to explain why the odds are stacked against any club hoping to repeat Leicester City's unlikely Premier League title win.

articles.headline: Mjällby wins Swedish league title to cap astounding season
articles.description: Mjällby, a tiny team from a remote fishing village next to the Baltic Sea, won the Swedish league title on Monday for one of the most remarkable achievements in European soccer.

images.name: Mjällby Swedish title [1024x576]
images.caption: Mjällby, a small team from a fishing village on the Baltic Sea, are champions of Sweden's Allsvenskan.
images.alt: Mjällby, a small team from a fishing village on the Baltic Sea, are champions of Sweden's Allsvenskan.

articles.headline: Ballon d'Or: Erling Haaland skips awards to watch Malmö game
articles.description: Erling Haaland won't attend Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony in Paris, preferring instead a trip to Sweden where his friend can win the league with Malmö.

images.name: Erling Haaland of Manchester City during the Premier League match between Manchester City FC and Southampton FC at Etihad Stadium [1296x729]
images.alt: Erling Haaland of Manchester City during the Premier League match between Manchester City FC and Southampton FC at Etihad Stadium

images.name: Premier League in numbers: 74 in 75 for Erling Haaland
images.caption: Take a look at the best stats from Saturday's Premier League action, as Erling Haaland's excellent scoring record continues.

articles.headline: Stockholm derby suspended after fans throw pyrotechnics
articles.description: The Stockholm derby between Djurgarden and Hammarby was suspended in the second half Sunday after supporters threw three smoke bombs onto the field.

images.name: Djurgarden v Hammarby - Pyrotechnics [1296x729]
images.caption: Djurgarden supporters' pyrotechnics disrupted the game, leading to a lengthy delay and eventual suspension.
images.credit: Magnus Lejhall/TT News Agency via AP

articles.headline: Swedish FA not considering VAR after clubs raise objections
articles.description: Sweden's top leagues will not look to implement a Video Assistant Referee (VAR) system after clubs voiced their opposition to the technology, Swedish Football Association (SvFF) Chairman Fredrik Reinfeldt said.

articles.headline: Orange County SC striker Ronaldo Damus closing in on move to Sweden's GIF Sundsvall - sources
articles.description: Orange County Soccer Club is close to finalizing the transfer of striker Ronaldo Damus to Sundsvall in the Swedish Allsvenskan, sources told ESPN.
